whyChoose: Access to globally ranked universities
Strong STEM, business, and research ecosystem
OPT and STEM OPT pathways for eligible students
Wide range of career and networking opportunities
studentVisaRequirements: Valid passport
Form I-20 from SEVP-approved institution
SEVIS fee payment
Financial documents
Academic records and test scores
Visa interview documents
Statement of purpose or study intent
tuitionFees: Average tuition: USD 20,000 - 55,000 per year
Premium private programs can be significantly higher
scholarships: Funding opportunities vary by university, program and applicant profile. Review each institution's funding options before you apply.

scholarshipHighlights.title: Merit Scholarships
scholarshipHighlights.description: University awards for strong academic performance, leadership and extracurricular achievements.

scholarshipHighlights.title: Graduate Assistantships
scholarshipHighlights.description: Teaching and research assistantships may provide a stipend, tuition support or both for eligible graduate students.

scholarshipHighlights.title: Fellowships & Research Funding
scholarshipHighlights.description: Research-focused programs may offer departmental fellowships and faculty-supported funding.

scholarshipHighlights.title: Need-Based & External Awards
scholarshipHighlights.description: Some institutions and external organizations offer need-based grants or scholarships for international students.

scholarshipNote: Check funding deadlines early: assistantships and major awards may require a separate application or an earlier admission deadline.
